notes: This documentation also describes the AMY2012 dataset of the same release (resstock_amy2012_release_1 on OEDI); the corpus is built once, under the AMY2018 release id.

The technical reference guide is converted from the ResStock repository at tag 2025_Release_1_upgrades_29_to_32. The PDF the site publishes (ResStockTechnicalReferenceGuide_2025_1.pdf, October 2025) was built from a later, untagged state of the same source, so the two can differ in places.
